warnings.very_large: A very large blast (2000 damage or more, or an outer radius of 20 m or more): it can kill the shooter and teammates nearby.
warnings.lingering_field: Leaves a lingering status field (gas, EMS, smoke...). The game holds at most 4096 of them and does not check the count: avoid it on fast-firing weapons.
warnings.shrapnel: Releases shrapnel or bomblets (projectiles of their own).
warnings.no_damage: Deals no damage itself (its effect is a status field, smoke or a push).
warnings.objective_packages: Loads two objective packages of about 300 MB before the write (up to 90 s, a hitch while they load); they stay loaded for the session.
